+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Group**            | **Example**    | **Mechanism**                                                                 |
+======================+================+===============================================================================+
| Beta blocker         | Metoprolol     | β~1~ antagonist. ↓G~s~ G protein coupled receptor → ↓ adenyly cyclase → ↓cAMP |
|                      |                |                                                                               |
|                      |                | ↓SNS overdrive → ↓remodelling                                                 |
|                      |                |                                                                               |
|                      |                | ↓Renin release → ↓Angiotensin 2 → ↓remodelling, ↓ intravascular volume, ↓SVR  |
+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ACE inhibitor        | Perindopril    | ↓Angiotensin 2, ↑bradykinin, ↑natriuretic peptides                            |
|                      |                |                                                                               |
|                      |                | ↓Remodelling                                                                  |
|                      |                |                                                                               |
|                      |                | ↓Na^+^/H~2~O retention                                                        |
+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ARB                  | Irbesartan     | (Like ACEi but no effect on bradykinin/natriuretic peptides)                  |
+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Neprilysin inhibitor | Saccubitril    | ↑Bradykinin, natriuretic peptides                                             |
|                      |                |                                                                               |
|                      |                | ↓Na^+^, H~2~O retention                                                       |
|                      |                |                                                                               |
|                      |                | ↓Remodelling                                                                  |
+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Diuretic             | Spironolactone | ↓Na^+^, H~2~O retention                                                       |
+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Cardiac glycoside    | Digoxin        | Inhibit Na^+^K^+^ATPase. ↑ICF \[Ca^2+^\]                                      |
+----------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
